retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, close-up portrait featuring a cool-toned duotone image paired with vibrant, vertically oriented orange script lettering.
triggerTerms: vertical orange script on blue portrait
diagonal head tilt portrait with headband

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, diagonally-tilted close-up of a smiling woman with dark curly hair and a wide headband, rendered in a cool blue-tinted grayscale with visible halftone grain. The composition is anchored by a large, bright orange script name running vertically down the right edge, contrasted by a smaller, light blue serif subtitle at the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal facial tilt vs. vertical text alignment
Soft photographic textures vs. sharp graphic lettering
Dark hair and headband framing the light-valued face
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of the primary display text
High-contrast facial features with defined eyebrows
Visible print-like grain or halftone texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 80% of the frame, tilted at a 45-degree angle from the top left toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the vibrant orange vertical script act as dual focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal tilt of the face from top-left to bottom-right, then moves upward along the vertical text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with the subject and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool light blue (background and skin highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portrait; high saturation contrast in the orange text against the muted blue base.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blue, black, white, and orange

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a brush-stroke feel
letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight mimicking a flat-tip brush
Slightly jagged edges suggesting a screen-printed texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Descenders and ascenders are compressed to fit the vertical column
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vibrant, organic script paired with a static, clean serif for structural balance.
graphicDevices: Halftone screen effect on the photograph

preserve: Orange color for the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic serif contrast for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, close-up portrait of a woman with curly hair and a black headband, tilted diagonally. Apply a cool blue duotone filter and a subtle halftone grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large name in vibrant orange brush-script vertically along the right edge. Add a smaller subtitle in light blue serif all-caps at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the main text vertical and orange?
Is there a visible halftone or print grain?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
The exact handwriting of the original script

mustAchieve: Strong color contrast between orange and blue

postGenerationChecks: Text is vertically oriented on the right side
Portrait has a distinct blue duotone effect
Orange text is the most saturated element
Halftone texture is visible upon inspection
recipe.reuseFormula: Cool-toned portrait + Vertical warm-toned script + Halftone texture = 90s Pop Aesthetic
